observations: Photo 0: A black 4-burner gas cooker with a front control panel and oven door closed. The brand name 'Rinnai' is visible on the front panel. The surface shows some wear and minor scratches. One burner has a blue center, others are silver. A watermark 'UNIQUE GLOBAL STORE' is overlaid.
Photo 1: The same cooker with the oven door open, revealing a metal rack inside. The oven interior appears dark and slightly soiled. The control knobs are visible on the right side.

Photo 2: Top-down view of the cooktop. The burners and grates are visible. The right front burner has a blue center, others are silver. A label is visible on the bottom right corner of the cooktop, but text is not legible. Watermark present.

claims.evidence: Brand 'Rinnai' is visible in photo 0, but 'German' origin is not confirmed by any visible label or marking. Rinnai is a Japanese brand, so this claim is likely false or misleading.
Photos show visible wear, scratches, and some soiling on the cooktop and oven interior, consistent with use.
No visual proof of testing or durability. Functionality cannot be confirmed from photos alone.

risks.proof: Video of all burners lighting and burning steadily, with a close-up of the gas connections and valves.
Video of oven door closing and heating element turning on, or a temperature test with a thermometer.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or corrosion inside oven or under cooktop
risks.proof: Close-up photo or video of the oven interior and underside of the cooktop, especially around the gas lines and connections.

proof_requests: Video of all burners lighting and burning steadily.
Video of oven heating up or close-up of oven interior and heating element.
Close-up photo of the label on the bottom right of the cooktop (photo 2) to read model number and origin.
Photo or video of the underside of the cooker to check for corrosion or damage.
response.reason: The brand 'Rinnai' is confirmed, but the claim of 'German' origin is unverified and likely false. Functionality of burners and oven cannot be confirmed from photos. Hidden risks like gas leaks or internal damage require proof before pricing. The item can be priced only after functional and condition proof is provided.
